updates.text: PRD v1.0 signed off by all stakeholders — requirements baseline frozen.
Benchmarked four competing parts; our TOPS/W target sits mid-pack at launch.
Cost model rebuilt on N4P wafer pricing; BOM lands 6% under ceiling.
Approved at exec staff review; budget released against the 132-week baseline.
IP contracts executed; PHY delivery schedule attached to vendor SOW.
Corner list rev A agreed: 9 corners × 3 modes, POCV derates from the foundry deck.
All IP POs issued; vendor delivery dates folded into the RTL integration plan.
Pushed rules approved by the foundry; array meets the density budget with 3% margin.
CDC closure complete — 0 waiver-pending crossings; report archived.
DV signoff review complete; scoreboard archived. Two functional-coverage waivers approved by architecture.
Patterns validated on the final netlist; STIL handed to test development.
LEC clean on all partitions; handoff package delivered to PD.
Rev C frozen — HBM PHY keep-outs finalized with the package team.
Global skew 38 ps → 22 ps after mesh rebalance on clusters 12–15.
82% routed. NoC crossbar overflow down to 1.1% after link re-bundling — DRC-clean ETA Friday.
Initial global route: 3.2% overflow concentrated in NoC crossbar; re-bundling NoC links with arch.
WNS −86 → −41 ps at SS 0.675 V after CTS rebalance; hold clean at FF −40 °C.
Blocked on updated package ball map — expected from package team today; escalated at PD standup.
Overflow 3.2% → 1.1% after NoC link re-bundling; monitoring daily during detail route.
Hold clean on 14/16 clusters after buffer insertion; remaining 2 clusters re-running tonight.
Interim mesh straps added: 4.8% → 4.1% in sims. Final answer needs the updated ball map.
Signoff STA env validated against PD timing on 3 blocks — deltas under 5 ps.
Tracking PD route daily; go/no-go checkpoint with PD lead set for Monday.
Checklist v0.9 circulated — 12 items still owner-less; chasing in Friday program review.
Freeze holds pending the last bump map delta from the PD final turn.
Warpage peaks at 118 µm at 245 °C — inside the 150 µm limit across all four corners.
Package inductance adds 0.9% to worst dynamic IR; decap budget under review with PD.
KGD coverage at 96.8% — closing the last scan chains to hit the 98% gate before stacking.
Supplier call: allocation letter expected next week; qual quantities committed verbally.
Probe card design frozen and released to the vendor; qualification slot booked.
